applicability.rationale: Applicability-only review of the exact native Ethereum CMTAT_EVCC deployment, whose verified constructor identifies UBS USD class AT-acc shares and ISIN SGXZ89386486. The authorized distributor's March 20, 2025 native-uMINT disclosure states daily NAV and daily subscription/redemption; UBS's November 4, 2025 release confirms an in-production native fund subscription/redemption workflow. These sources establish an applicable internal fund-NAV pricing path without a borrower-collateral or liquidation branch. They do not establish the private valuation policy, deployed NAVLink/controller identity, complete pricing-authority execution reach, or independent valuation safeguards; aggregate oracleRisk.confidence remains limited.
